CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets Have Event Notifications Enabled
Description: S3 buckets found without Event Notifications configured to trigger actions (such as SNS topics, SQS queues, or Lambda functions) when objects are created, removed, or modified.
Risk: Lacking event notifications hinders real-time visibility and threat detection workflows, delaying responses to unauthorized file uploads, deletions, or data modifications.

Recommendation.Text: Configure S3 bucket event notifications to publish object activity to Amazon SNS, SQS, or AWS Lambda to enable real-time security monitoring, automated processing, and audit logging.
